kjv: [as] truly [as] I (Yahweh) live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD
mine: truly, as I (Yahweh) live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the glory of Yahweh
note: Hebrew chai-ani weyimmale ... is an oath formula ("as I live and as the earth is filled ..."), whose content follows in vv. 22-23; the KJV turns the second clause into an independent prophecy.

mine: shall be shepherds in the wilderness
note: Hebrew ro'im means "shepherds/grazing"; the KJV's "wander" gives the effect (nomadic life) rather than the word.

kjv: ye (Israel) shall know my (Yahweh's) breach of promise
note: Hebrew tenu'ati (from nu' "hinder, frustrate") is God's opposition or displeasure toward them; "breach of promise" implies God broke his word, which the text does not say.
